title: Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim, La
body:
haula
wa la quwatta illa bi-llahi-l 'Aliyu-l 'Aziem...'Kulli yaumin Huwa fi
sha'an...' There is no limit for the Greatness of Allah, and every moment He
is in another state

Audhu bi-llahi mina shaitani rajim, Bismillahi-r-Rahmani-r-Rahim, La haula wa la quwatta illa bi-llahi-l
'Aliyu-l 'Aziem...'Kulli yaumin Huwa fi
sha'an...' There is no limit for the Greatness of Allah, and every moment He
is in another state. The smallest part of time contains countless states and
conditions. There are billions of people, and for everyone of them there is
another Tajalli. Every Tajalli, manifestation, is a state of being of Allah.
His Power and Gretaness have no limit. Things appear and disappear, and
always the states change...
What opens the door to the hidden, what opens secret doors, is tefekkur,
reflective thinking. Without this you are like a Mongoloid- backward, they
cannot think, and they are not responsible. Then there are also the
square-head people, who imprisoned themselves in four corners. They think
they are the best, they want to lead 'their own' life, they don't look to
what is outside of them and they don't want anyone to interfere. Like this
are the young people of today: No one shall interfere in their life, neither
parents nor the government.

All systems in the 21st century are to distract people from thinking. People
have become disorientated, like airplanes without radar- they don't see what
is before them and what is behind them. A snail has two antennas to feel and
react. But people are without radar and without antenna now. And they are
like copies- without feeling, without senses...They want to make people a
not thinking mass which is easy to govern and direct. It started in the
West, but it is like this everywhere now. Our people accept everything that
is coming from the West without critical judgment, and refuse everything
that comes from the East as bad, inferior. No matter what, it is always
second class, backward. There is a third class, a fourth class- the African
people- and the fifth class is the animal class. They didn't leave us any
honour, we fell down to the animal level. That is a big Bela, misfortune.
There is some people who write about a plan for a 'new world'. And people
are sleeping, they are not thinking and not understanding. The word used is
'global'- one man governs all and everyone obeys. 'Cosmopolitan' they call
it. No freedom or personality will remain... Now in Europe 15 states decided
to make a common currency. And really the currency represents their
personality. That plan is from Shaitan, not from Allah. We come from one
couple, but after we became people each with a private speciality, identity.
Now they want to throw everything in one pot. The English are not joining,
and they cannot throw them out. If Germany also would not agree, would they
throw them out? But they try to make people uniform, their brain not to work
anymore. That is the way of Shaitan. Are you teaching your children about
the history of your people? Our history is not only the last 8o years.
They made a law that men and women are equal, and it turned everything
upside down. A man is a man, a woman a woman. He must live his manhood, she
her feminity. Now people are ill...If a ship had two captains giving orders,
the ship would sink...They want to finish humanity and create a 'new world'.
And people are not awake, they are square-head people, imprisoned in a box.
Everything is presented to them, and beyond that they are not thinking.

So nowadays it is difficult to tell them anything or try to explain
something to them...
O Allah, only You may save us, You have the power- send us the saviour. May
Your word be listened to in the world and the Sultanate of Shaitan be
destroye.
Lefke - 11.12.2001
